name: Po
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
interaction: Chooses a player or no-one. After a no-one choice, the next time it acts it must choose 3 players in order, each of whom dies.
drunk_or_poisoned: Kills fail. Choosing no-one while drunk or poisoned still grants 3 choices next time.

rulings.text: The first night does not count as choosing no-one.
An attack that fails (target survives) does not grant 3 attacks; only a no-one choice does.
When charged, the Po must pick 3 players and may not pick no-one.
An Exorcist block is not a no-one choice; a pending 3-attack carries over to the next night the Po acts.
The 3 attacks resolve in the chosen order (e.g. attacking a Goon makes the Po drunk for later attacks).

test_scenarios.name: single kill
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Po, Bob Chef, Carol Empath, Dave Mastermind, Eve Monk

test_scenarios.name: charge then triple
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Po, Bob Chef, Carol Empath, Dave Mastermind, Eve Monk, Frank Sailor, Gina Tea Lady
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses no-one. Night 3: Alice chooses Bob, Carol, Eve.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 2 nobody dies; Night 3 Bob, Carol and Eve die.

test_scenarios.name: drunk charge still counts
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Po, Bob Chef, Carol Empath, Dave Poisoner, Eve Monk, Frank Sailor
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice is drunk (Sailor) and chooses no-one. Night 3: Alice is poisoned and picks Bob, Carol, Eve. Night 4: Alice is healthy.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 3 nobody dies; Night 4 Alice gets only one choice.

test_scenarios.name: failed attack is not a charge
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Po, Bob Soldier, Carol Chef, Dave Baron, Eve Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob. Night 3: Alice acts.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob survives; on Night 3 Alice may choose only one player.

test_scenarios.name: Exorcist does not charge
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Po, Bob Exorcist, Carol Chef, Dave Baron, Eve Empath, Frank Monk
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses no-one. Night 3: Bob exorcises Alice. Night 4: Alice acts.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 3 Alice does not act; Night 4 Alice chooses 3 players.
